assignedTasks.title: MongoDB Schema Design: Topics & Timer Jobs
assignedTasks.description:
Design the Topic Collection. Requirements:
1. Fields: Title, Description, Category, CreatorID.
2. Timer attribute: 'expiresAt' Date (Must allow queries for 'time left').
3. Cron job or TTL index to automatically archive/close topics after 27 hours.
4. Participant array or count reference.

assignedTasks.title: MongoDB Schema Design: Messages & Threading
assignedTasks.description:
Design the Message Collection supporting recursive threading. Requirements:
1. Fields: RoomID, AuthorID, Content, Timestamp.
2. Threading: 'parentMessageId' (Nullable, points to parent).
3. Optimized queries to fetch a parent message + all children recursively.
4. Reactions document map embedded in message.

assignedTasks.title: Socket.io Chat Architecture
assignedTasks.description:
Implement the Server-Side WebSockets. Requirements:
1. Handle authentication via socket handshake.
2. Room joining logic (Socket.io rooms per TopicID).
3. Broadcasting 'message_insert' and 'reaction_update' events.
4. Handle user presence ('typing...', active user counts).
